versions.content: The ARTI template shall support task specific ARTI additions Description: The ARTI template shall define a mechanism to allow task specific ARTI parameters. Rationale: ARTI needs task specific evaluations. The Template shall define a class to define additional parameters to a task as well as an instance to define values of the task. The task instance shall include a reference to the task definition in the EcuC description. Dependencies:  Use Case: Debuggers and Tracing tools need specific task related information to display and trace the task activity. Supporting Material: -
